svg.text: S18 The data TLBs, set by set
A template where the player marks the set and way a translation sits in. The L1 and L2 TLBs come before the walk.
The L1 indexes 18:14 and the L2 21:14.
◇ One lookup a cycle, shared by requests to one page.
12 ways, tag and frame per way
? It may be shared by the cluster, beside the L2.
~ Each entry holds its page size, of up to five.
The player fills one cell, a set and a way.
upper levels from a walk cache
a walker per core, by the L2 TLB
an evicted L1 entry is not kept
